findings.summary: tests/runtime-archive-links.test.ts is not a declared verification input (startup trace showed all three criteria untraced). trace.mjs --tests on that file maps spec-7-1/2/3 to lines 43, 55, 66. The reviewer used it as a check input; the queue was not edited.

Only files ending in lowercase .md are treated as Markdown. Probe: docs/notes/u.MD with a relative link into the feature was neither rewritten nor listed (it is not named by full path, so the non-Markdown list misses it too). Same for .markdown.
findings.assumption: The spec checks .md only; other extensions are rare.

findings.summary: Prose and non-Markdown mentions are found only by the full project-relative path (docs/features/x). A relative mention such as `../features/x` in prose, or a slug-only mention, is not listed.
findings.assumption: The spec checks the full path docs/features/x; that is the reading taken.

findings.summary: The reference says rewrites happen in live Markdown outside the features and archive folders, but does not say the rewrite is limited to the docs root (Markdown outside the docs root is listed, not rewritten, unless the docs root is the project root).
The repo's installed .joycraft/runtime/archive.mjs differs from payload/ (as do cleanup.mjs and wiring.mjs); payload/PIN matches payload/. Left to the release/install flow.
